messages:
Pranav: quick note — tried onboarding with the new monorepo starter (next + app-router + tailwind + LlamaClient) and ran into auth refresh failures when deployed to Vercel edge functions.
Pranav: local dev works, but on edge builds the SDK's token refresh hits 401 and the retry logic doesn't kick in.
Eli: hmm, which SDK version? are you on the new unified js client?
Pranav: yes `@redwood/inference@0.12.0` (the one with edge support). repro steps: `git clone https://git.redwood/monorepo-starter && cd web && npm i && npm run build && vercel --prod`.
Maria: thanks — can you paste the error snippet?
Pranav: Dev server log: `Error: unauthorized\n at refreshToken (/node_modules/@redwood/inference/dist/edge.js:45:12)`
Pranav: also noticed `fetch` in edge runtime returns 401 but no retry header and no attempt to re-auth before returning to app.
DevEx Bot: FYI security: token refresh endpoints require origin header present for Vercel edge. See internal note: https://intranet.redwood/edge-auth-quirks
Eli: ok that matches a known gap — edge client needs to defer refresh to server-side adapter when running under Vercel's edge runtime. Should have fallback.
Kevin: is this an SDK parity issue (node vs edge)? we may have different code paths for `isNode` vs `isEdge`.
Pranav: yep — the monorepo starter bundles the client into the app route, so it runs in edge. Node path has retry loop but edge path returns fast.
Maria: low-friction fix: add client-side check that forces server-side refresh by calling `/api/auth/refresh` on 401, then retry original request. But that's a hack.
Sam: is there an issue open? sounds like we need a small SDK patch and a docs note for the starter.
Pranav: not yet. I can open an issue with a minimal repro in the starter repo.
Eli: assign to me for the SDK patch. quick plan: (1) update edge adapter to queue refresh requests and respond with a 307 to a refresh endpoint, (2) add automatic single-retry on 401, (3) bump client version and update starter template.
Kevin: add a unit test for the retry on edge with mocked `fetch` returning 401 then 200.
Maria: and add a short section in the starter README about deploying to Vercel with env var ESM_FALLBACK or `EDGE_RUNTIME=nodejs` until patch lands.
Pranav: created issue in starter repo: https://git.redwood/monorepo-starter/issues/42 — includes logs and minimal steps. tagging @Eli.
Sam: nice. Can we also include an e2e smoke in the eval-harness that deploys the sample to vercel-preview to catch this earlier?
Eli: good idea — we can add a lightweight CI job that runs `vercel --confirm` against the sample and hits a simple generation endpoint. failing fast.
DevEx Bot: CI suggestion: add `ci/vercel-smoke.yml` template to devex repo.
Pranav: I'm going to open a PR to the starter: small README tweak + link to issue. will also add a comment with workaround snippet: `if (res.status===401) await fetch('/api/auth/refresh'); return client.request(...)`
Maria: thanks — marking this as P1 DX for starters. small perf hit but big onboarding friction.
Kevin: ping me once the SDK PR is up and I'll help with the test harness.
Sam: also leaving a note in the roadmap board: "edge auth retry parity" for next sprint.
Eli: will follow up with a changelog entry and upgrade guide for starters/docs.
Pranav: thanks team :raised_hands:
